headline: Baseten near $1.5B funding at $13B valuation
summary: AI inference startup's valuation surges 160% in months
details: AI inference company Baseten is close to finalizing a $1.5 billion funding round at a $13 billion valuation.
This round would represent a 160% increase in valuation in less than half a year, following a $300M Series E at a $5B valuation just five months ago.
The deal is said to be co-led by Spark Capital, Sands Capital, Altimeter Capital, and Wellington Management, with some investors coming in at $13B and others at $11B.
caption:
Can Baseten's valuation surge continue? $1.5B funding at $13B valuation

AI inference company Baseten is close to finalizing a $1.5 billion funding round at a $13 billion valuation.

This round would represent a 160% increase in valuation in less than half a year, following a $300M Series E at a $5B valuation just five months ago.

The deal is said to be co-led by Spark Capital, Sands Capital, Altimeter Capital, and Wellington Management, with some investors coming in at $13B and others at $11B.
